note: Asking prices in euros from the original listing on the day each home was added. Medians describe the homes RealHunt lists (cheap for their country, checked by a person), not a country's whole market. Rules, taxes and costs are general information, not legal or tax advice.
sentences: On 28 November 2026, RealHunt lists 8 homes for sale in the United Kingdom, each one checked by a person.
In the United Kingdom, the median asking price of those 8 homes is €126,500 (€1,806 per m², from the 8 homes with a known size); the cheapest costs €95,449 and the most expensive €198,400.
Taxes and fees add about 3–9% to the price of a home in the United Kingdom (figures as of 2026).
With 8 homes this is a small sample, so the median for the United Kingdom is a rough guide.

buying.costs_breakdown: In England and Northern Ireland, Stamp Duty Land Tax (SDLT) is 0% up to £125,000 and 2% from £125,001 to £250,000, plus a 2% surcharge for non-UK residents and a further 5% if you already own a home anywhere, so a non-resident who owns another home pays 7% up to £125,000 and 9% to £250,000; solicitor (conveyancer) about 0.6-1% with a typical minimum of around £2,100 including VAT; Land Registry fee £20 to £230; searches extra; the seller pays the estate agent.
buying.can_foreigners_buy: Yes. There are no nationality restrictions on buying homes anywhere in the UK and no visa is needed, but buying does not give a right to live there.
buying.annual_property_tax: Owners or occupiers pay council tax to the local council, and many councils in England charge second homes a premium of up to 100% from April 2025.
buying.rental_income_tax: Non-resident landlords pay UK income tax on rent at 20%, 40% or 45%, with 20% deducted at source by the agent or tenant unless HMRC approves gross payment, and the rates on property income are set to rise to 22%, 42% and 47% from April 2027.

homes.title: Two-bedroom house with garden and off-street parking in Wingate, County Durham
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios con jardín y aparcamiento propio en Wingate, Condado de Durham
homes.summary: This is a two-bedroom mid terrace house in Wingate, County Durham. The accommodation has a lounge and dining room, a kitchen, two larger than average double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Outside there is a garden with landscaped areas and off-street parking on a private drive. Wingate is within reach of the A19, Teesside, Sunderland and Durham City. The living area is 91 m2. Asking €95,449, about €1,049/m².

homes.title: Terraced 2-bedroom family house with covered yard in Bishop Auckland, County Durham
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 2 dormitorios con patio cubierto en Bishop Auckland, County Durham
homes.summary: This terraced family home in Bishop Auckland is offered for sale with no onward chain. The ground floor offers an entrance hallway, a spacious living room, a dining room and a kitchen, and the first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom. Externally there is an enclosed covered yard with a garage door leading to the rear lane, which could be used as secure car parking. Shops, supermarkets and schools are a short distance away, and public transport links to Darlington, Durham and Newcastle. Asking €95,509, about €1,061/m².

homes.title: 2-bedroom terraced house in good condition with rear yard in Hunwick, County Durham
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de 2 dormitorios en buen estado con patio trasero en Hunwick, County Durham
homes.place: Hunwick, County Durham, North East England
homes.summary: This modern terraced house is in good condition and offered with no onward chain. The ground floor has an entrance hall leading into an open plan living room, dining room and kitchen, and the first floor has two double bedrooms and a family bathroom. Outside there is on-street parking to the front and an enclosed rear yard with gated access to the back lane. The village has a primary school, village hall, church, pub, tea room and a local shop, with frequent buses to Durham, Darlington and Newcastle. Asking €95,509, about €1,194/m².

homes.title: Furnished two-bedroom house with Moray Firth sea views in the harbour town of Macduff
homes.title_es: Casa de dos dormitorios amueblada con vistas al fiordo de Moray en la ciudad portuaria de Macduff
homes.summary: A well-presented semi-detached house in the centre of Macduff, a coastal town on the Moray Firth in north-east Scotland, sold fully furnished and ready to move into. 70 m² with an entrance hall, an open-plan kitchen and living room with all appliances included, two bedrooms and a fully fitted bathroom upstairs. The front bedroom looks out over the Moray Firth. Modern fittings throughout, and the advert says it works equally as a permanent home. Freehold. Asking offers over £110,000 (about €126,500), around €1,800/m². Council tax band B.

homes.title: Well-kept three-bed semi-detached house with solar panels in Enniskillen, Fermanagh
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de tres dormitorios bien mantenida con paneles solares en Enniskillen, Fermanagh
homes.summary: Asking £140,000 (about €161,000). A three-bedroom semi-detached house in a quiet area of Enniskillen, Co. Fermanagh, well maintained inside and out. About 107 m²: a fitted kitchen with dining space, utility area and downstairs WC, a bright living room with an open fire, and three bedrooms (two doubles) with a family bathroom upstairs. It has solar panels, insulated dry-lining on the outside walls, a new condensing boiler and some new radiators. Stone-walled front garden and an enclosed rear patio with a covered seating area and a large shed. Rates £652 a year.

homes.title: Refurbished period townhouse with a double garage in Lack village, County Fermanagh
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de época renovada con garaje doble en el pueblo de Lack, County Fermanagh
homes.summary: Asking £172,500 (about €198,400) for a 107 m² traditional end-terrace townhouse that has been fully and carefully refurbished, keeping its original character. The lounge opens to a contemporary kitchen and dining area, there are three bedrooms with an en suite to the main one, plus a stylish family bathroom. Oil central heating and PVC double glazing. Outside it has a generous end site with parking, a yard and a large double garage. Photos show green hills beside the house and a bright, well kept interior. Rates £702 a year. EPC E52.

homes.title: Renovated two-bedroom end terrace with garage in historic Greyabbey, Northern Ireland
homes.title_es: Casa adosada de dos dormitorios renovada con garaje en el histórico Greyabbey, Irlanda del Norte
homes.summary: Asking £169,950 (about €195,400) for an 80 m² end-terrace house in the heart of historic Greyabbey, comprehensively renovated within the last five years. Downstairs there is a bright open-plan living and dining room, a modern kitchen with integrated appliances and a WC. Upstairs are two double bedrooms, the main one with an en suite, plus a family shower room. A substantial garage and workshop sits behind the house, with street parking in front. It is turnkey and sold as a home or holiday base; it is run as a holiday let at present. Rates £1,299 a year.

homes.title: Traditional two-bedroom cottage with wood burner and large garden in Whithorn, Galloway
homes.title_es: Cottage tradicional de dos dormitorios con estufa de leña y jardín grande en Whithorn, Galloway
homes.summary: A traditional terraced cottage in the centre of Whithorn, in the far south-west of Scotland. 67 m² with two well-proportioned bedrooms, a living room with a wood-burning stove and a recently refurbished modern kitchen. Behind the house, steps lead up to a large enclosed garden with a kept lawn, mature planting, a raised paved sitting area, a greenhouse and a generous outbuilding. Freehold, mains water and sewerage, electric heating. Asking offers over £105,000 (about €121,000), around €1,800/m². Council tax band A, the lowest band.
